title: Z.A.R.V.I.S. Runtime Skill Result v1
description: Result envelope for a completed skill invocation. Always paired with a zarvis.skill.invocation.v1 by invocation_id. Terminal statuses are final and must not be retried.

status.description: Terminal status. 'denied' means the approval gate rejected execution.

output.description: Skill output, validated against skill_manifest.output_schema. Present only when status is 'succeeded'.

message.description: Must not contain credentials, keys, or raw provider error details.

tool_calls.description: Audit record of tool calls made during execution. Must not include credentials or raw responses.

idempotency_key.description: Echo of the invocation idempotency key.

replayed.description: True when this result was served from a prior successful execution with the same idempotency_key.
